title: Welcome to Carzana Interiors
text: Welcome to Carzana Interiors Welcome to the Carzana Interiors website where you will find information on reupholstery, the design and manufacture of contract and domestic upholstery, curtains, blinds, fabrics and associated items. We have a barn full of antique and vintage sofas and chairs awaiting restoration. We are always happy to discuss a project with you; so if you have any questions feel free to get in touch by giving us a call or visiting us on site at our Oast house in the heart of the Kent countryside.

title: About Us
text: About Us Carzana Interiors is a family run business now into its 4th generation with the skills and expertise of the upholstery and soft furnishing business being passed down through the generations. Now run by mother and son team (Liz and Michael Carzana) we have been at our present premises for 21 years and have gradually expanded to occupy our current 4500 square feet Oast House workshops and showrooms in the Kent countryside. Here both our wide ranging furniture that we lovingly restore or build to order from our own furniture ranges, as well as our curtain and upholstery workshops are housed. With all work being carried out in house we are more than happy to show you around so you can see how the various pieces are given a new lease of life.

title: History
text: History Carzana Interiors is a 4th Generation family business. Charles Britt started the family trade off just after the first world war when he and his partner Walter Kemp took over the business of George Bottin to form Britt & Kemp in Bexhill, East Sussex. Anthony Britt, Charles' son started working in the family business at age 14, and is still on hand with his years of expertise today at almost 93!! Anthony went on to form A & J Britt Upholstery with wife Joy and when Charles decided to retire Britt and Kemp was absorbed into A & J Britt. Elizabeth Britt was brought up in the family business and was learning the skills from mother Joy from when she was old enough to walk. After a brief spell as a chef and other jobs she came back to re-upholstery and soft furnishing when she married husband Chris Carzana and went on to form Carzana Upholstery in the late 80's. Having formed close ties with a number of interior designers Carzana Interiors grew to cover the south east and Carzana Upholstery set up Forstal Furnishings at Forstal Farm in Lamberhurst in the late 90's which is where we are still based today. Liz's son Michael Carzana, also growing up in the family business, was always helping to strip furniture or hand sew covers and covered his first wing chair at 14. After studying Aerospace Engineering at university and after a spell working with one of the countries longest running airlines he decided to work alongside the family business making and supplying curtains and blinds. It was in 2008 that the 3 divisions of the family business decided to combine and work under the family name of Carzana Interiors, which is where we are today. Going forward, now Michael's brothers Richard and Nick are also involved, Richard with the upholstery side of the business and Nick taking care of the woodwork and framing. And with the next generation coming along, maybe Michaels son will get involved if he shows the same attention to detail that has run in the family so far.

title: How Green are We?
text: How Green are We? Whilst the very nature of our business is to recycle furniture making it re-useable once again. We have various other recycling partnerships in place to help the environment; these include the following: Beneficial Foundation, Materials Bank @ Portsmouth We regularly deliver our useable textiles, off-cuts of fabric, cushion covers, used curtains, foam off-cuts plus fabric cardboard tubes. These are used by schools, colleges, playgroups etc for a variety of projects. (You may leave any unwanted curtains with us for transporting to Portsmouth if required). Barby Keel, animal sanctuary All our office paper waste is shredded and used by the rescue centre for bedding for small animals. Used cushion inners and covers for dog / cats beds. We recycle all cans / plastic / glass bottles / batteries / newspaper etc. where appropriate. All scrap metals i.e. curtain tracks, springs etc are collected regularly for recycling. Low voltage strip lighting is used throughout our premises and workshop. Vintage fabrics are washed and made into unique cushions and throws.

title: Loose Covers
text: Previous Next Use the arrows to scroll through product images. Loose Covers Our loose covers are all cut on the item of furniture ensuring a good fit. As with all loose covers we make a slight allowance in case of shrinkage when cleaned. For cleaning of your loose covers we always recommend that they are dry cleaned, however some fabrics can be washed on a cool wash depending on the individual care codes of your chosen fabric. (the sofa and stripe chair are fully fitted piped covers, while the floral chair and terracotta chair and sofa are loose drop covers without piping.) Contact Us for More Information

title: Curtains
text: Previous Next Use the arrows to scroll through product images. Curtains All of our curtains are made in house ensuring that our orders are on time and to our high standards and yours. We can make your curtains with pencil pleat, triple or double pleat or goblet headings and with either cotton sateen lining or blackout lining and, if required, interlined. We can offer a hand finished or bag lined finish to your curtains suiting a variety of budgets. Whatever your requirements we are happy to discuss the various options and try to find the right combination for you. With any renovation project we appreciate that delivery on time and on budget is a stressful business and adds to an already stressful situation. At Carzana Interiors we are able to take a little of the stress out of your window dressings by being able to help come up with a design and colour scheme to work towards. Once this is set then we can make this a reality being able to source fabrics, poles/tracks and manufacture and fit your curtains, blinds and pelmets to the high standards you require. We deliver a complete service giving you one less job to worry about. Contact Us for More Information
